#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);

    int evenRuns = 0;
    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        size_t j = i + 1;
        while (j < s.length() && s[j] == s[i]) {
            ++j;
        }
        if (((j - i) & 1) == 0) {
            ++evenRuns;
        }
        i = j;
    }

    std::cout << evenRuns << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
